definition.interpretation: The invalid measurement suggests the instrument numeric-observation@1 failed to capture variance across the specified coupling range, potentially due to insufficient sensitivity or uncontrolled noise in the python random seed generation.
definition.limitations: Numeric measurement instrumentation is currently unvalidated for this specific parameter space. Stochastic variance may mask underlying causal divergence mechanisms.
definition.next_step: Refine the experiment protocol to include robust variance normalization or switch to a comparative qualitative analysis of path outcomes.

definition.reason: Previous measurement failed; experiment needs redesign to control for stochastic noise and ensure valid variance capture.
definition.stop: Completion of three successful trials or identification of persistent measurement error.
definition.uncertainty: It is unclear if the failure is instrumental or if the hypothesis itself is poorly operationalized.
